taxonomy_note: Initial root-cause lens; reassess final mapping.

controls.boundary: JWT validation and token lifecycle — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Open token issuance, verifier configuration, key source, claim validation and downstream account lookup. Distinguish access, ID, reset and other token purposes even when they share a signer.
controls.controlled_verification: With local nonsecret keys and synthetic claims, compare a valid intended token against one correctly signed token for a different issuer/audience/purpose and one invalid signature. Trace the exact verifier-to-account consumer. When inspecting key selection, determine whether untrusted token metadata can choose a trust anchor, not merely a key identifier in a trusted set.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Decoding a token is not signature verification. A signed token with a harmless unused claim is not a bypass. Do not claim real cross-service acceptance from a standalone mocked verifier.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind verification to the expected issuer, audience, purpose and allowed key/algorithm source; enforce the declared expiry/revocation contract at the consumer. Retest intended and cross-purpose tokens plus key rotation compatibility.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
